title: Enbridge Gas Rebates 2026: Home Renovation Savings and Winterproofing
desc: Enbridge Gas rebates in Ontario for 2026: how Home Renovation Savings treats gas homes, the $500 per ton heat pump rate, free Winterproofing for eligible households and what Enbridge does not pay.
badge: Gas homes: $500 per ton for a heat pump
lead: Enbridge Gas runs Ontario's home rebates together with Save on Energy under one program, Home Renovation Savings, and the gas side pays less than the electric side. This page sorts out what Enbridge customers get, what is free and what the Enbridge website still gets wrong.
cards_heading: What Enbridge customers can claim in 2026
cards_intro: We read Enbridge's residential page and the Home Renovation Savings pages on October 3 to 5, 2026. Enbridge's own page is out of date on the thermostat, so we use the program page.

cards.title: Heat pump (gas homes)
cards.note: For an air-source heat pump in a home heated by Enbridge gas or any rental, against $1,250 per ton up to $7,500 for homes heated by electricity, oil, propane or wood. Ground-source is a flat $3,000 for gas homes.

cards.title: Smart thermostat
cards.note: Claimed with a code at checkout or a receipt within 60 days. Enbridge's page still says $75, which is out of date.

cards.title: Home Winterproofing
cards.note: Free insulation and draft proofing for eligible households, including those on Ontario Works, ODSP, LEAP or the Guaranteed Income Supplement.

cards.title: Gas furnaces
cards.note: Home Renovation Savings does not pay for a gas furnace.

cards.title: ERV and HRV incentive
cards.note: Enbridge's ventilator incentive covers multi-family, hotels and commercial offices, and sends homeowners to Home Renovation Savings.

cards.title: Assessment stream cap for gas homes
cards.note: Insulation, windows and a heat pump water heater inside the assessment stream are capped at $5,000 for gas-heated homes against $10,000 for others.

sections: Home Renovation Savings is delivered by Enbridge Gas and the Independent Electricity System Operator through Save on Energy. The same measures appear for everyone, but the amounts depend on how you heat. A home heated by Enbridge gas gets a lower heat pump rate and a lower overall cap, because the program is steering electric, oil and propane homes harder toward electrification. If you are on gas, read the gas row, not the headline number.
What a gas home gets for a heat pump

Gas homes get $500 per ton up to $2,000 for an air-source heat pump, or $3,000 flat for ground-source, against $1,250 per ton up to $7,500 for electric, oil, propane and wood homes. Rental homes follow the lower rate as well. Whether a heat pump suits a gas home depends on your bills, so ask an installer to compare running costs at your current gas price before you decide, not only the rebate.
The assessment stream and the gas cap

Insulation, windows and doors, air sealing and a heat pump water heater are paid through the assessment stream, which needs a first home energy assessment before work starts, at least two qualified measures and a post-assessment by the program's dates. The total is capped at $5,000 for gas-heated homes and $10,000 for homes heated by electricity, oil, propane or wood. See our Home Renovation Savings guide for the full rules.

Home Winterproofing gives free insulation and draft proofing to households that meet the eligibility checks or take part in programs such as Ontario Works, ODSP, LEAP or the Guaranteed Income Supplement. Enbridge's quiz uses income thresholds that run from $48,220 up to $127,576 and above depending on household size. Free is better than a rebate, so check this before paying for anything.
Where Enbridge's own page is behind

Enbridge's residential page lists a $75 instant smart thermostat rebate. The Home Renovation Savings page, which runs the rebate, says $125. We follow the program page because it is where you claim. If a contractor quotes the $75 figure, ask which page they read.
claim_heading: How to claim as an Enbridge customer
claim_steps: Check how you heat: Enbridge gas uses the lower rates on this page.
Check Home Winterproofing eligibility first if your income may qualify.
Book the first home energy assessment before any work if you plan insulation, windows or a water heater.
For a heat pump, get written pre-approval and use the gas-home rate.
Claim the thermostat with a code or a receipt within 60 days.

faq: Does Enbridge pay for a gas furnace?
No. Home Renovation Savings does not pay for a gas furnace.
How much is the heat pump rebate for a gas home?
$500 per ton up to $2,000 for air-source, or $3,000 flat for ground-source.
Is the smart thermostat rebate $75 or $125?
$125 under Home Renovation Savings. Enbridge's own page still shows $75, which is out of date.
Yes, for households that meet its eligibility checks or take part in listed assistance programs.
Is there an Enbridge rebate for an HRV?
Not for houses. Its incentive covers multi-family buildings, hotels and commercial offices.
